name: toolsenabled-site-studio
description: Edit static sites in a private working copy, with checkpoints, local preview and human-controlled export.

site_directory.title: Static site folder
site_directory.description: Absolute path to built static website files. Site Studio edits a private copy.

data_directory.title: Private working state folder
data_directory.description: Absolute path to a new or empty private folder outside the site and export folders. Use one folder per site and client. Keep it outside the plugin installation.

export_directory.title: Human export destination
export_directory.description: Absolute path to a new destination folder, or the original site folder, whose parent exists. Keep it separate from state and outside the plugin installation. The human dashboard requires explicit export confirmation.
